title: Mr. Okwaro Rides His Boda
subtitle: Working Fathers of Soroti
author: Anthony Mwesigwa
description: Follow Mr. Okwaro as he rides his boda-boda, taking passengers around Soroti town.
keywords: boda-boda, motorcycle, taxi, Uganda, Soroti, family, work, father, transport
dedication: For all the boda-boda riders who help people get where they need to go.
authorBio: Anthony Mwesigwa is a passionate storyteller from Kampala, Uganda, dedicated to creating engaging educational books for young African readers.
backCoverText: How do people travel around town? Join Mr. Okwaro on his boda-boda as he takes passengers, earns money, and serves his community. A story about service and responsibility.
